summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes 727KB obfuscated sibling script on install
details: The package's preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temporary directory, extracts it, chmods it executable, and immediately invokes it via execFileSync against math_init.js shipped in the package. math_init.js is a 727KB heavily obfuscated file (obfuscator.io-style rotating string-array dispatcher with hex-named identifiers) that is not declared in the package.json `files` field (which lists only `bin/`). Executing an obfuscated sibling script through a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime at preinstall time is not required to deliver a prebuilt native binary (the package advertises itself as `bin/umadev`); the pattern grants the author install-time code execution on installer machines via a channel that Node-based scanners do not observe. While the runtime is fetched from Bun's official GitHub release, the code executed under it is the package's own obfuscated bytes rather than the runtime's own installer, so this is a dropper for author-controlled code, not an official-runtime install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
